taskPlan.title: Aggregate defect signals
taskPlan.instruction: Fetch both issue and observability signals for CASE-2026-0042, preserve source IDs, and return a structured normalized signal summary with evidence references.

taskPlan.title: Map repository impact
taskPlan.instruction: Read src/redisPool.js and src/order.js from the approved fixture and report affected files, regression tests, digests, and evidence references.

taskPlan.title: Produce evidence-grounded RCA
taskPlan.instruction: Fetch observability signals for CASE-2026-0042 and search historical cases for redis pool timeout duplicate order. Return ranked root-cause hypotheses with direct evidence references.

taskPlan.title: Create minimal isolated patch
taskPlan.instruction: Create workspace WS-CASE-2026-0042-AGENTTEAMS with idempotency key CASE-2026-0042:agentteams:workspace; read src/redisPool.js and src/order.js; run baseline tests; set redisPoolConfig to poolSize 80 and queueTimeoutMs 800; make createOrder return status 409 with the existing order for a duplicate idempotency key. Use stable per-write idempotency keys and return workspace, baseline test, patch, rollback, and evidence references.

taskPlan.title: Run regression quality gate
taskPlan.instruction: Run tests in workspace WS-CASE-2026-0042-AGENTTEAMS with idempotency key CASE-2026-0042:agentteams:verify and return pass/fail counts, artifact, output summary, and evidence references.

taskPlan.title: Verify L2 approval boundary
taskPlan.instruction: Call release.canary for CASE-2026-0042, version devorbit-agentteams-0.7.0, approvalId APR-CASE-2026-0042, idempotency key CASE-2026-0042:agentteams:canary, and regressed false. Do not provide, invent, or bypass an approval token. Treat the expected policy denial as SUCCESS_WITH_NOTES and report terminal state needs_human with the denial evidence reference.

taskPlan.title: Persist safe terminal knowledge
taskPlan.instruction: Write a redacted knowledge card for CASE-2026-0042 with terminal state needs_human, the redis pool and duplicate-order pattern, prevention actions, tags, and evidence references. Use idempotency key CASE-2026-0042:agentteams:knowledge and do not claim a cloud-account execution.

task: 这是 DevOrbit 官方 AgentTeams v1.2.2 本地运行验证，不是普通问答。已注册的确定性证据运行器会使用当前 Leader 身份，通过官方 TeamHarness projectflow 和 taskflow 创建顺序 DAG，并把任务实际发送给 7 个团队 Worker。不要调用 workerflow__worker_agentflow，不要创建临时 subagent，也不要由 Leader 代做 Worker 任务。请保留本次请求上下文，等待真实 Worker 在 Team Room 中完成任务。闭环必须覆盖：intake-worker 聚合 issue 与 observability 信号；impact-worker 读取代码并给出影响面；rca-worker 检索观测与历史案例；patch-worker 在隔离工作区复现并提交最小补丁；verify-worker 执行测试门禁；release-worker 在没有签名审批 token 的情况下验证 L2 拒绝边界；learning-worker 沉淀 needs_human 安全终态。每个 Worker 都必须由自己的 QwenPaw 运行时调用指定 DevOrbit MCP，并提交结构化状态与证据引用，不得声称使用云账号。运行器只在 7 个 TeamHarness 任务均完成、7 项 MCP 审计均匹配后，才会用 Leader 的官方 TeamHarness message 工具在本 DM 发布以 DEVORBIT_RUNTIME_RESULT 开头的 JSON 摘要。
